tools.name: search
tools.description: Find websites whose page source (HTML, JavaScript, CSS) contains a string: a library name, a script url, a tracking or widget id, a meta tag, any code fragment. Results are ranked by site popularity. Query syntax: quote an exact phrase ("angular.min.js"); several words must all appear; a leading min

tools.name: account
tools.description: The account behind the token: plan, searches used today and left, rate limit, result limits. Spends nothing.

tools.name: read_docs
tools.description: PublicWWW's own documentation and price list, in Markdown: query syntax and operators, regular expressions (snipexp:), country domains, ready-made example queries, clusters and extraction, the REST API, this MCP server, site languages, plans and prices with what each plan opens. Without page or page

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: The account's clusters - saved lists of websites - newest first: id, name, number of domains, creation time. An account keeps at most 100. Spends nothing.

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: A page of the domains in one cluster. Spends nothing.

tools.name: create_cluster
tools.description: Save a list of websites as a cluster, to extract data from them or combine with other clusters. From a search: pass 'query' (PublicWWW syntax, as in the search tool) - the cluster takes the results up to the plan's limit, and it costs one search. From a list: pass 'domains' - names or urls; only sit

tools.name: combine_clusters
tools.description: A new cluster from existing ones: 'and' - domains in every cluster, 'or' - in any of them, 'diff' - in the first cluster but not in the second (exactly two). Spends nothing.

tools.name: extract_from_cluster
tools.description: Pull values out of the page source of every website in a cluster: contacts, social profiles, analytics and tag ids, anything a regular expression can match. Easiest: name ready-made presets - email (email addresses from mailto: links), phone (phone numbers from tel: links and schema.org telephone),

tools.name: build_signatures
tools.description: Find signatures that lead to more websites like the ones in a cluster: their common platform, theme, plugin, tracker, network or owner. Each result is a ready search - pass its query to the search tool in double quotes to find more such websites. Best on a cluster made by one search or of one networ

tools.name: rename_cluster
tools.description: Give a cluster a new name. Spends nothing.

tools.name: delete_cluster
tools.description: Delete a cluster for good. It cannot be undone - confirm with the user first.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search" is 1049 chars, far longer than this server's median (173). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, create_cluster · Private data: account, extract_from_cluster · Public sink: extract_from_cluster · Destructive: delete_cluster.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, create_cluster · Private data: account, extract_from_cluster · Public sink: extract_from_cluster · Destructive: delete_cluster

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
